subject: Architecture
title: Art Deco: The Machine Age in Style
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Art Deco: The Machine Age in Style.

hook.text: Art Deco made buildings look like luxury machines — geometric, sleek, and gleaming with chrome.

buildup.text: Named after a 1925 Paris expo, Art Deco fused Egyptian motifs, jazz rhythms, and factory forms.

discovery.text: The Chrysler Building and Empire State Building are both Art Deco — zigzag crowns and setback terraces.

twist.text: Art Deco thrived during the Depression. Glamour was an escape from economic misery.

climax.text: Miami Beach's Art Deco district has over 800 buildings — the largest collection in the world.

punchline.text: The world was broke. The buildings pretended otherwise.

quiz.question: When did Art Deco get its name?
options: A 1930 museum exhibit in New York
